# Golden vectors of decision 0004, the lookup formats.
#
# Source: docs/decisions/0004-lookup-formats.md in ghostcoin-core/ghost, whose
# reference checker scripts/check_decision_0004.py prints every block with
# --print. Values are hex; S is SHA3-256 and K is Keccak-256, each over
# len(tag) || tag || inputs; integers are big-endian; a global position is 5
# bytes.
#
# One [name] block per vector, one "field = value" line per field.
